# Bitácora.btc

> Open collaborative map of Bitcoin communities, nodes and merchants in Latin America. Education, events and on-chain pulse. No custody, no exchange.

Bitácora.btc is a community logbook (bitácora) run by Consciencia Bitcoin from Colonia del Sacramento, Uruguay, with LATAM Cripto Mom. It helps people find Bitcoin circular economies nearby and learn self-custody.

## Site

- Home (single page): /
- Map / globe: /#mapa
- About / Consciencia Bitcoin: /#conciencia
- Community & events: /#comunidad
- News pulse: /#pulso
- History of Bitcoin: /#historia
- Network data: /#red
- Market (candles, liquidations, ETFs): /#mercado
- FAQ: /#faq-seo

Languages: Spanish (default), Portuguese, English (`?lang=es|pt|en`).

## What it is not

Not an exchange, wallet, broker or custodian. It does not hold keys or user funds.

## Publisher

- Organization: Consciencia Bitcoin
- Backing: LATAM Cripto Mom
- Place: Colonia del Sacramento, Colonia, Uruguay (−34.47, −57.84)
- Area served: Latin America

## Cite as
